facts.fact: Ipanema beach extends between Arpoador and Jardim de Alah beside Avenida Vieira Souto.
The beach is associated with Garota de Ipanema by Tom Jobim and Vinicius de Moraes.
Sports and sunset gathering are part of the described beach culture.

title: Riotur — Praia de Ipanema
